{{Top|leg}}
The '''Consorts' Sitting Room''' was located near the entrance to the [[Royal Residence]] in the [[Fountain Palace]] on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]]. It was where the potential suitors to the [[Queen Mother]] would wait for her to call on them.
